title: Clinical Audit, Service Evaluation and Quality Improvement (PDSA)

hook.en: You do not need a grant or a university to do research that matters. Auditing your own clinic against a standard, then improving it in small cycles, is the fastest way to raise the care your patients receive. And it is a perfect first project for any therapist.
hook.ur: Aham research karne ke liye grant ya university ki zaroorat nahi. Apne clinic ka kisi mayar ke muqabale mein audit aur phir chhote chakkron mein behtari mareezon ko milne wali care barhane ka sab se tez tareeqa hai. Aur yeh har therapist ka behtareen pehla project hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll tell audit, service evaluation, quality improvement and research apart, run a simple audit cycle, use PDSA to test a change, and report your work with SQUIRE.
goal.ur: End tak aap audit, service evaluation, quality improvement aur research mein farq karenge, saada audit chakkar chalayenge, tabdeeli aazmane ke liye PDSA istemal karenge, aur apna kaam SQUIRE se report karenge.

text.en: **Clinical audit** checks whether practice meets an agreed **standard** (for example, "all patients after total knee replacement have knee flexion measured at discharge"). **Service evaluation** asks how a service is working. **Quality improvement (QI)** tests changes to make care better, usually in rapid **PDSA** cycles: **Plan, Do, Study, Act**. **Research** aims to produce new generalisable knowledge and normally needs ethics approval; audit and QI usually do not, but check your local rules.
text.ur: **Clinical audit** jaanchta hai ke practice tay shuda **mayar** (masalan "total knee replacement ke baad har mareez ki discharge par ghutne ki flexion nape") par poori utarti hai ya nahi. **Service evaluation** poochhta hai ke service kaise kaam kar rahi hai. **Quality improvement (QI)** care behtar karne ke liye tabdeeliyan aazmata hai, aam taur par tez **PDSA** chakkron mein: **Plan, Do, Study, Act**. **Research** nayi, aam hone wali maloomat paida karna chahti hai aur aam taur par ethics ki manzoori chahti hai; audit aur QI ko aam taur par nahi, lekin apne muqami qaide dekhein.

text.en: Think of **a driving test and then practice**. The audit is the test: how often do we pass the standard? QI is the practice: try a small change, see whether the next test improves, adjust, try again. You do not rebuild the car; you tune it one change at a time.
text.ur: **Driving test aur phir mashq** sochein. Audit test hai: hum kitni baar mayar par poore utarte hain? QI mashq hai: ek chhoti tabdeeli aazmayein, dekhein agla test behtar hota hai, tabdeel karein, dobara aazmayein. Aap gaari dobara nahi banate; ek waqt mein ek tabdeeli se tune karte hain.

title.en: A simple audit and PDSA cycle

steps.title: Choose a standard
steps.detail: Take it from a guideline or local policy and keep it measurable, for example "falls risk recorded for every patient over 65 at first visit". || Mayar chunein

steps.title: Measure current practice
steps.detail: Review 20 to 50 recent records and count how many meet the standard. This is your baseline. || Maujooda practice naapein

steps.title: Plan a small change (Plan, Do)
steps.detail: Pick one change, such as a reminder on the assessment form, and try it for two weeks. || Chhoti tabdeeli plan karein (Plan, Do)

steps.title: Study and act
steps.detail: Measure again. If the figure rose, keep the change and spread it; if not, adjust and repeat. || Jaiza lein aur amal karein

steps.title: Share what you learned
steps.detail: Tell the team, plot results on a run chart and report using SQUIRE headings. || Jo seekha share karein

question.en: A clinic reviews 30 records and finds that 12 had falls risk recorded. They add a tick-box to the assessment form and re-check after a month. What is this?
question.ur: Ek clinic 30 records dekhta hai aur paata hai ke 12 mein girne ka khatra likha tha. Woh assessment form mein tick-box jorte hain aur ek mahine baad dobara dekhte hain. Yeh kya hai?

feedback.en: Records were counted, not interviews analysed.
feedback.ur: Records ginay gaye, interviews ka tajziya nahi hua.

text.en: **Auditing without acting.** An audit that finds a gap and then sits in a drawer helps no one. Close the loop: agree changes, re-audit, and share results. Another trap is choosing too many standards: pick one or two that matter. Avoid blaming individuals; look at the system, such as forms, time and training.
text.ur: **Audit karna lekin amal na karna.** Audit jo kami dhoondh kar daraaz mein pari rahe kisi ki madad nahi karta. Chakkar band karein: tabdeeliyan tay karein, dobara audit karein aur nateeje share karein. Ek aur jaal bohat se mayar chunna hai: ek ya do ahem chunein. Afraad ko ilzam na dein; nizam dekhein, jaise forms, waqt aur training.

text.en: **Start tomorrow with a ten-patient check.** Choose one thing you believe you always do, like asking about red flags, and look at the last ten notes. If one in three is missing, that is your project. Share the result with colleagues without blame and agree on one change. This is a perfect first piece of work for a CV or a conference poster.
text.ur: **Kal se das mareezon ki jaanch shuru karein.** Ek cheez chunein jo aap samajhte hain hamesha karte hain, jaise red flags poochhna, aur pichhle das notes dekhein. Agar teen mein se ek chhoot raha ho to wohi aap ka project hai. Nateeja saathiyon ke saath bina ilzam ke share karein aur ek tabdeeli par mutafiq hon. Yeh CV ya conference poster ke liye behtareen pehla kaam hai.

question.en: What is a run chart, and why is it better than a before-and-after comparison?
question.ur: Run chart kya hai aur before-and-after muqabale se behtar kyun hai?

answer.en: A run chart plots a measure over time, point by point, so you can see trends, shifts and the effect of changes as they happen. A two-point before-and-after comparison can hide a trend that was already rising. Five or six points before and after, with the change marked, give a far more honest picture of whether your change made a difference.
answer.ur: Run chart ek naap ko waqt ke saath point ba point banata hai taake aap rujhan, tabdeeliyan aur tabdeeliyon ka asar hota hua dekh sakein. Do points ka before-and-after muqabla woh rujhan chhupa sakta hai jo pehle se barh raha tha. Tabdeeli se pehle aur baad ke paanch ya chhe points, tabdeeli ke nishan ke saath, ye kahin zyada imaandar tasveer dete hain ke aap ki tabdeeli ne farq daala ya nahi.

beats.patient: A physiotherapy department wants all patients after hip fracture to stand within 24 hours of surgery. An audit of 40 patients shows that only 55 percent do.
beats.assessment: They find that the main delay is waiting for the first review on weekends.
beats.treatment: They trial a weekend early mobilisation list for four weeks, record the percentage each week and plot it on a run chart.
beats.reassess: The percentage rises to 85 percent, the ward keeps the list and shares the result at a local meeting.

text.en: **Protect patient data.** Use anonymous records or codes, store data securely, and follow your clinic's policy. If an audit reveals a patient safety problem, report it through the proper route at once; do not wait for the next audit cycle.
text.ur: **Mareez ka data mehfooz rakhein.** Gumnaam records ya codes istemal karein, data mehfooz rakhein aur apne clinic ki policy follow karein. Agar audit mareez ki safety ka masla dikhaye to foran sahi raaste se report karein; agle audit chakkar ka intezar na karein.

text.en: The SQUIRE 2.0 guidelines set out what a quality improvement report should include, such as the problem, the context, the intervention, the study of the intervention and the results, so that others can learn from and repeat the work. A systematic review of the use of PDSA cycles found that many reports did not apply the method fully, such as not making predictions, not using small-scale tests or not documenting cycles, which limited the value of the results.
text.ur: SQUIRE 2.0 guidelines batate hain ke quality improvement report mein kya hona chahiye, jaise masla, context, intervention, intervention ka study aur nateeje, taake doosre seekh sakein aur kaam dohra sakein. PDSA chakkron ke istemal ke ek systematic review ne paya ke bohat si reports ne tareeqa poori tarah lagu nahi kiya, jaise peshgoi na karna, chhote pemane ke test na karna ya chakkar document na karna, jis ne nateejon ki qeemat mehdood ki.

text.en: **Standard, Measure, Change, Re-measure.** Set a standard, measure practice, try one change, and measure again.
text.ur: **Mayar, Naapein, Tabdeeli, Dobara naapein.** Mayar tay karein, practice naapein, ek tabdeeli aazmayein, aur dobara naapein.

summary.en: Audit checks practice against a standard; QI tests changes in small PDSA cycles; research aims at new general knowledge.
summary.ur: Audit practice ko mayar se jaanchta hai; QI chhote PDSA chakkron mein tabdeeliyan aazmata hai; research nayi aam maloomat chahti hai.

summary.en: Close the loop by re-measuring after a change, and plot results on a run chart.
summary.ur: Tabdeeli ke baad dobara naap kar chakkar band karein, aur nateeje run chart par banayein.

summary.en: Protect patient data, report safety problems immediately and share what you learn.
summary.ur: Mareez ka data mehfooz rakhein, safety ke masail foran report karein aur jo seekha share karein.
